summary.zh: 把代码打包成可分发的库或 CLI
summary.en: Package Python code for PyPI with pyproject.toml.

description.zh: 整理项目结构、编写 pyproject.toml 并发布到 PyPI，也覆盖命令行工具的打包方式。准备对外发布库、构建 CLI 或分发内部 Python 代码时使用。
description.en: Sets up the project layout and pyproject.toml, then publishes libraries or CLI tools to PyPI. Use it when releasing a package, building a command-line tool or distributing shared Python code.
